notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road elevations are edited from Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) DEM5A ground tiles. Edited from GSI elevation tiles: bilinear ground elevations along paired road stations, compressed within 0.25 m of those samples. Each bridge deck is linearly interpolated only between its sampled approach endpoints; ground samples under the bridge are excluded from that deck. Road levels and clearance are estimates, not a road or bridge survey. No capture date is supplied by these tile responses. The bridge uses explicit paired source stations; cross-sections never select another road branch. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations, not verified curb locations. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Borders retain their feature licences and unverified status. Imagery loads externally; no meshes, image bytes or videos are stored.

refinement.note: Sparse visible pavement/white-edge measurements correct the pit straight, lower-road approaches, hairpin exit and back-straight/130R/chicane-entry false detections. The lower road hidden under the bridge interpolates between visible approach edges. The two source routes reuse the same physical image measurements projected onto their own cross-section grids. Other sections remain automatic, unverified estimates; interpolated sections are not a continuous manual trace, and curb placement is not measured.

crossings.note: OSM-selected back-straight bridge; visible imagery approaches bracket the deck. Lower road edges hidden by the bridge require explicitly measured approach anchors and interpolation.

elevation.note: Edited from GSI elevation tiles: bilinear ground elevations along paired road stations, compressed within 0.25 m of those samples. Each bridge deck is linearly interpolated only between its sampled approach endpoints; ground samples under the bridge are excluded from that deck. Road levels and clearance are estimates, not a road or bridge survey. No capture date is supplied by these tile responses.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.
